roles.name: Visitor
roles.description: Anonymous public visitor (any audience). Browses the landing page, switches EN/ID, watches the 3D scenes and animations, follows anchor navigation.

roles.name: Prospective seller (Early Adaptor applicant)
roles.description: Parts store, garage/workshop, or distributor considering the Early Adaptor program. Completes the 4-step Join Waitlist wizard (business type, business name, contact channels, details) and optionally continues to WhatsApp after submitting.

roles.name: Buyer (notify-me subscriber)
roles.description: Car owner in Jakarta who wants to be notified at launch; uses the buyer strip's 'Get notified' action (mailto in the design; may become a lightweight form).

roles.name: Investor
roles.description: SEA commerce-infrastructure investor; reads the Investors section, requests the deck via mailto, or emails a founder directly.

roles.name: Founding team (lead recipient)
roles.description: Yavet, Salman, Ferdi — receive every waitlist submission and buyer/investor email, and follow up personally via WhatsApp or email. Not a logged-in role on the site itself; consumes leads through the delivery channel chosen at strategy phase (e.g. email notification, stored records, or dashboard export).
